headword: {精神疾患|せいしんしっかん}

definitions.explanation: A medical term for disorders affecting mental health, including conditions such as depression, anxiety disorders, schizophrenia, and bipolar disorder. This is the standard formal/clinical term used in medical and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {精神疾患|せいしんしっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I am receiving treatment for a mental illness.

examples.japanese: {精神疾患|せいしんしっかん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。

notes:
{精神疾患|せいしんしっかん} is the standard clinical/formal term. In casual conversation, ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧ (illness of the heart/mind) or ⟦メンタルヘルス→メンタルヘルス：08596_mentaruherusu⟧ (mental health) are more common. The less formal ⟦{精神病|せいしんびょう}→精神病：26248_seishinbyou⟧ exists but can carry negative connotations.
